_meta.what_this_is: A request with a total deadline that fans out to a chain of downstream calls, each taking some time. The deadline is a promise to the caller: respond within deadline_ms no matter what. Correct handling propagates the REMAINING budget to each hop (deadline minus time already spent); the buggy handling hands each hop the FULL original timeout, so no hop knows the global deadline and a slow chain runs right past it. Two chains: 'slow' overruns the deadline if uncorrected, 'fast' fits either way (so the bug hides on it).
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. deadline and per-hop durations in milliseconds, hand-picked so the slow chain sums past the deadline and the fast one does not.
